about: 正式工程（现在是序章）界面上的文字。剧情和经文在 content/episodes/ 里。books 书卷名；kinds 四种文字的名字；hints 剧情结束后的操作提示（按节点 id）；titleVerse 开始页上的经文（ESV 和和合本一字不改）；page 写在页面上的固定文字（按钮、开始页、结尾页），index.html 里用 {{bi:page.start.title}} 这样的记号引用；aria 读屏软件念的说明，不分语言；game 游戏进行中显示的文字。除了 aria 和 game 里少数几项，每一条都是 { en, zh }。{n}、{w} 这样的记号会被换成数字或名字，[W] 这样的方括号会画成键帽，都不要删。改完运行 npm run validate:content。

touch.en: Use the joystick at the bottom left to move. Follow the faint light.
touch.zh: 用左下角的摇杆移动，跟着远处的微光走

desk.en: Press W or ↑ to walk. Follow the faint light in the distance.
desk.zh: 按 W 或 ↑ 往前走，跟着远处的微光

touch.en: Your lamp is lit. Hold the button at the bottom right to jump and glide.
touch.zh: 灯亮了。按住右下角的按钮，可以跳起来滑翔

desk.en: Your lamp is lit. Press Space to jump; hold Space in the air to glide.
desk.zh: 灯亮了。按空格跳跃，在空中按住空格可以滑翔

day3.en: The land has risen! Explore freely — glowing potsherds are hidden around the map.
day3.zh: 陆地升起来了！可以自由探索。地图上藏着发光的陶片

day7.en: The garden in the east is open. Follow the light east.
day7.zh: 东方的园子开启了。跟着光，往东走

e2.en: Stone bridges cross the four rivers, so you can walk all the way around the spring.
e2.zh: 四道河上有石桥，可以绕着泉源走一圈

touch.zh: 你学会了“命名”：点“命名”按钮

desk.zh: 你学会了“命名”：按 F 键

text.en: “Your way was through the sea, your path through the great waters; yet your footprints were unseen.” (Psalm 77:19, ESV)
text.zh: “你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的脚踪无人知道。”（诗篇 77:19）

backToMap.en: Back to the Map of Light

line1.en: You witnessed the seven days of creation and walked into the garden in the east.
line1.zh: 你见证了创造的七日，走进了东方的园子。

line2.en: The next chapter, “Where Are You?” (Genesis 3), is being made by all of us together.
line2.zh: 下一章《你在哪里？》（创世记 3 章），正在由我们一起制作。

helpDesk.en: Computer: [W A S D] or arrow keys to move, hold [Shift] to run, [Space] to jump (hold it in the air to glide), drag the mouse to look around, scroll to zoom, [B] opens the journal, [L] switches language.
helpDesk.zh: 电脑：[W A S D] 或方向键移动，按住 [Shift] 奔跑，[空格] 跳跃（在空中按住滑翔），拖动鼠标看四周，滚轮拉近拉远，[B] 打开图鉴，[L] 切换语言。

helpPhone.en: Phone: use the joystick at the bottom left to move, drag the right half of the screen to look around, and tap the button at the bottom right to jump. Headphones recommended.
helpPhone.zh: 手机：左下角摇杆移动，右半边屏幕拖动看四周，右下角按钮跳跃。建议戴上耳机。

credit.en: Prologue v0.5 · A church youth project
credit.zh: 序章 v0.5 · 教会青少年项目

aria.map: Back to the Map of Light

windowDone.en: {w} is complete. Open your journal to see it.

onyx.en: Hint: it has something to do with one of Eden’s rivers.
onyx.zh: 提示：它和伊甸的一道河有关。

noVerses.en: No verses lit yet. Follow the light and witness each moment.
noVerses.zh: 还没有点亮经文。跟着光走，见证每一个时刻。

learnHint.en: Learn new gestures from people in the Bible.
learnHint.zh: 向圣经人物学习新的姿态。

resting.en: Resting… (press again or move to get up)
resting.zh: 安息……（再按一次或走动就会起来）

barrier.en: The garden in the east isn’t open yet. First follow the light through all seven days.
barrier.zh: 东方的园子还没有开启。先跟着光走完七日。
